products.description: This canvas painting print adds wheel-y, wheel-y colorful citrus style to your abode! Two colorful lime slices form the wheels of this old-fashioned bicycle, for a fun look perfect for kitchens, kids' rooms, and more. Printed with fade-resistant archival inks on gallery-wrapped canvas around anti-shrink pine wood bars, it includes mounting hardware so it is ready for hanging right out of the box. Plus, it's proudly made in the USA! Three Posts™ Baby & Kids Size: 8" H x 12" W x 0.75" D
